newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - in dollars, lire and yen.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - in dollars, lire and yen.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' latest Eurobond trade ideas focused on dollars, lire and yen.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY This switch offers a pick-up of around 25 basis
points and one credit notch from IBCA for virtually the same liquidity, maturity and coupon.
STRATEGY This is a credit improving trade offers a yield
pick-up of around 16 b.p. and a cash takeout of over two points. Other expensive bonds to consider switching out of include ABN 05/01 (pick-up 13 b.p.) and Bayer 10/01 (pick-up 9 b.p.)
STRATEGY This bond offers good value at five b.p.
through LIBOR on the offer side. The issuer consistently trades at a LIBOR spread of over 20 b.p. through.
STRATEGY This is a good name offered at level
inconsistent with its credit rating and past performance.
STRATEGY San Paolo believe the above issues provide good
value and they should outperform other Eurolira bond issues.
STRATEGY This trade involves a shortening of duration
giving up around 4 b.p. where on an historic basis the EIB 7.45 pct has traded in a range of -4 b.p. to -25 b.p.
STRATEGY This Euroyen lengthening switch offers a yield
pick-up of around 108 b.p. The bond on the sell-side is trading at a large premium to par, while the 10-year euro is offered at a much smaller premium because of the low coupon rate.
